description: This Go source file is part of the Kubernetes code generator tools, specifically for generating apply configuration types and utility functions for Kubernetes API resources.

methods.name: NameSystems
methods.description: Returns the name system used by the generators in this package.

methods.name: DefaultNameSystem
methods.description: Returns the default name system for ordering the types to be processed by the generators.

methods.name: GetTargets
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of generator targets for code generation based on input packages and arguments.

methods.name: typeName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the type's package and name.

methods.name: targetForApplyConfigurationsPackage
methods.description: Creates a generator target for a specific package of apply configurations.

methods.name: targetForUtils
methods.description: Creates a generator target for utility functions.

methods.name: targetForInternal
methods.description: Creates a generator target for internal embedded schema.

methods.name: goName
methods.description: Determines the Go package name for a given group version, possibly overridden by comments.

methods.name: packageTypesForInputs
methods.description: Collects package types from input directories, excluding internal packages.

methods.name: groupVersion
methods.description: Extracts group and version information from a package, possibly overridden by comments.

methods.name: isInternalPackage
methods.description: Checks if a package is internal based on presence of ObjectMeta.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Checks if a member is internal based on absence of JSON tags.

methods.name: hasObjectMetaField
methods.description: Checks if a type has an embedded ObjectMeta field.
